expected.finding: **[P2]** `scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py` — Rollbacks stop further ancestry checks. `decide()` checks regressions only for `origin == "revision"`, and `unjudged_ancestors()` stops at a rollback. If v3 is rolled back to v2’s configuration as v4, later evidence showing v2 was worse than v1 cannot trigger that rollback—even through subsequent descendants. Record the restored version and follow its ancestry when evaluating regressions.

**[P2]** `scripts/render-rsi-dashboard.py`, `rows_findings` — The “Field traces” column uses raw snapshot lengths, bypassing keyword-definition and truncation checks. After keywords change, it can display evidence collected for a different definition as corroboration; unsearched topics display zero instead of unknown. Use the validated counts from `cur["anchor"]` and render unknown values as `n/a`.
